title: Notebook Putt: Daily Mini Golf
short: Mini golf courses sketched in ballpoint on a notebook page. Six new holes every day.
desc:
Putt your way through mini golf courses sketched in ballpoint on a notebook page. Drag anywhere to set direction and power, then let go. Bank shots off the walls, slow down in the sand, and if you splash into water you take a one-stroke penalty and replay from your spot. Red bumpers kick the ball back.

▶ Today's 6: every date builds the same six-hole course. A finished round stamps your record calendar alongside a scorecard.
▶ Ladder: an endless climb, one floor per hole, with more turns and ponds the higher you go.
▶ Records: rounds played, best round, holes in one and highest ladder floor on a monthly calendar.
▶ Fair courses: every hole has an open path from tee to cup, and par comes from actually playing the hole. Can't sink it in eight? The ball is picked up and you move on, so you never get stuck.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
